predecessors.name: Thuringian kingdom (Cliopatria 'Thuringian states')
predecessors.text: the same Thuringian land, continued in Cliopatria's next row from 476

successors.name: Kingdom of the Franks
successors.text: the Thuringian kingdom, conquered by the Franks in 531-532: Theuderic I 'took control of the Unstrut region'

ledger.x: 476: Cliopatria's Kingdom of Thuringia row begins on the land of its Thuringian states row (469-475).
531: the Franks of Austrasia attack Thuringia.
532: the fighting ends with the kingdom conquered.

wars.name: Frankish conquest of Thuringia
wars.outcome: Frankish victory: 'Theuderic I defeated Herminafrid in two battles and took control of the Unstrut region'; the kingdom was 'conquered by the Franks in 531-532'.

certainty.note: A tribal kingdom with no recorded frontier; the early forms may have reached the Rhine and northern Bavaria.
